title: 第14课 · 你把水果拿过来
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 14 — 你把水果拿过来 · Please bring the fruit here

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 打扫
items.py: dǎsǎo
items.en: to clean, to sweep

items.zh: 干净
items.py: gānjìng
items.en: clean

items.zh: 然后
items.py: ránhòu
items.en: then, after that

items.zh: 冰箱
items.py: bīngxiāng
items.en: refrigerator

items.zh: 周太太：客人就要来了，你怎么还不打扫房间啊？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Kèrén jiù yào lái le, nǐ zěnme hái bù dǎsǎo fángjiān a?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: The guests are about to arrive — why haven't you cleaned the room yet?

items.zh: 周明：别着急，我让孩子们打扫呢，客人来的时候，他们会把房间打扫干净。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Bié zháojí, wǒ ràng háizimen dǎsǎo ne, kèrén lái de shíhou, tāmen huì bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng.
items.en: Zhou Ming: Don't worry, I've told the kids to clean it. By the time the guests come, they'll have the room clean.

items.zh: 周太太：那你也不能看电视啊。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nà nǐ yě bù néng kàn diànshì a.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Even so, you can't just watch TV.

items.zh: 周明：你让我做什么？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Nǐ ràng wǒ zuò shénme?
items.en: Zhou Ming: What do you want me to do?

items.zh: 周太太：先把茶和杯子放好，然后把冰箱里的西瓜拿出来。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Xiān bǎ chá hé bēizi fànghǎo, ránhòu bǎ bīngxiāng li de xīguā ná chulai.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: First set out the tea and cups, then take the watermelon out of the fridge.

items.zh: 周明：太热了，我还是先把空调打开吧。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Tài rè le, wǒ háishi xiān bǎ kōngtiáo dǎ kāi ba.
items.en: Zhou Ming: It's too hot; I'd better turn on the air conditioner first.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在打电话 — On the phone

items.zh: 洗澡
items.py: xǐ zǎo
items.en: to take a bath/shower

items.zh: 节目
items.py: jiémù
items.en: programme

items.zh: 同事：你在忙什么呢？刚才打你的手机你也不接。
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐ zài máng shénme ne? Gāngcái dǎ nǐ de shǒujī nǐ yě bù jiē.
items.en: Colleague: What are you busy with? I just called your mobile and you didn't answer.

items.zh: 小刚：对不起，我刚洗了个澡，没听见。有什么事吗？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ gāng xǐle ge zǎo, méi tīngjiàn. Yǒu shénme shì ma?
items.en: Xiaogang: Sorry, I was just taking a shower and didn't hear it. What's up?

items.zh: 同事：我想问问你公司里的一些事情。
items.py: Tóngshì: Wǒ xiǎng wènwen nǐ gōngsī li de yīxiē shìqing.
items.en: Colleague: I'd like to ask you about a few things at the company.

items.zh: 小刚：你先等一下，我去把电视关了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ xiān děng yīxià, wǒ qù bǎ diànshì guān le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Hold on a moment, let me go and turn off the TV.

items.zh: 同事：没关系，你先把电视节目看完吧，然后再给我回电话。
items.py: Tóngshì: Méi guānxi, nǐ xiān bǎ diànshì jiémù kànwán ba, ránhòu zài gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.
items.en: Colleague: No problem. Finish watching your TV programme first, then call me back.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在小明家 — At Xiaoming's home

items.zh: 月亮
items.py: yuèliang
items.en: moon

items.zh: 像
items.py: xiàng
items.en: to be like

items.zh: 盘子
items.py: pánzi
items.en: plate

items.zh: 刮风
items.py: guā fēng
items.en: to be windy

items.zh: 叔叔
items.py: shūshu
items.en: uncle

items.zh: 阿姨
items.py: āyí
items.en: aunt

items.zh: 故事
items.py: gùshi
items.en: story

items.zh: 声音
items.py: shēngyīn
items.en: sound, voice

items.zh: 同学：今晚的月亮真漂亮，像白色的盘子一样。
items.py: Tóngxué: Jīn wǎn de yuèliang zhēn piàoliang, xiàng báisè de pánzi yīyàng.
items.en: Classmate: The moon is really beautiful tonight, like a white plate.

items.zh: 小明：是啊，外边也不刮风，我们坐在外边一边看月亮一边吃东西，怎么样？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Shì a, wàibian yě bù guā fēng, wǒmen zuò zài wàibian yībiān kàn yuèliang yībiān chī dōngxi, zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Xiaoming: Yes, and it isn't windy outside either. How about we sit outside and eat while looking at the moon?

items.zh: 同学：好啊，我先把桌椅搬出去，然后你把水果拿过来，我们听叔叔阿姨讲讲他们年轻时候的故事。
items.py: Tóngxué: Hǎo a, wǒ xiān bǎ zhuōyǐ bān chuqu, ránhòu nǐ bǎ shuǐguǒ ná guolai, wǒmen tīng shūshu āyí jiǎngjiang tāmen niánqīng shíhou de gùshi.
items.en: Classmate: Great. I'll carry the table and chairs out first, then you bring the fruit over, and we'll listen to your uncle and aunt tell stories from when they were young.

items.zh: 小明：太好了！记得给大山打个电话，让他马上过来。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Tài hǎo le! Jìde gěi Dàshān dǎ ge diànhuà, ràng tā mǎshàng guolai.
items.en: Xiaoming: Wonderful! Remember to give Dashan a call and tell him to come over right away.

items.zh: 同学：不用打了，你听外边的声音，一定是大山。
items.py: Tóngxué: Bùyòng dǎ le, nǐ tīng wàibian de shēngyīn, yīdìng shì Dàshān.
items.en: Classmate: No need to call. Listen to the voice outside — that must be Dashan.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — Fruit rice

items.zh: 菜单
items.py: càidān
items.en: menu

items.zh: 简单
items.py: jiǎndān
items.en: simple

items.zh: 香蕉
items.py: xiāngjiāo
items.en: banana

items.zh: 你吃过水果饭吗？
items.py: Nǐ chī guo shuǐguǒ fàn ma?
items.en: Have you ever eaten fruit rice?

items.zh: 你在饭馆的菜单上见过水果饭吗？
items.py: Nǐ zài fànguǎn de càidān shang jiàn guo shuǐguǒ fàn ma?
items.en: Have you ever seen fruit rice on a restaurant menu?

items.zh: 你想学着做水果饭吗？
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng xuézhe zuò shuǐguǒ fàn ma?
items.en: Would you like to learn to make fruit rice?

items.zh: 其实做水果饭很简单，先把米饭做好，然后再把一块块新鲜的水果放进去，水果饭就做好了。
items.py: Qíshí zuò shuǐguǒ fàn hěn jiǎndān, xiān bǎ mǐfàn zuòhǎo, ránhòu zài bǎ yī kuàikuài xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ fàng jinqu, shuǐguǒ fàn jiù zuòhǎo le.
items.en: Actually, making fruit rice is very simple: first cook the rice, then put in pieces of fresh fruit, and the fruit rice is ready.

items.zh: 你可以做苹果饭、香蕉饭，要是你愿意，还可以做西瓜饭。
items.py: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò píngguǒ fàn, xiāngjiāo fàn, yàoshi nǐ yuànyì, hái kěyǐ zuò xīguā fàn.
items.en: You can make apple rice or banana rice, and if you like, you can even make watermelon rice.

items.zh: 多吃新鲜水果对身体好。
items.py: Duō chī xīnxiān shuǐguǒ duì shēntǐ hǎo.
items.en: Eating lots of fresh fruit is good for your health.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (把字句 A把B + V + 结果/趋向补语)

items.zh: 我把衣服洗干净了。
items.py: Wǒ bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le.
items.en: I've washed the clothes clean.

items.zh: 妈妈还没把饭做好呢。
items.py: Māma hái méi bǎ fàn zuòhǎo ne.
items.en: Mum hasn't finished cooking the meal yet.

items.zh: 请同学们把铅笔拿出来。
items.py: Qǐng tóngxuémen bǎ qiānbǐ ná chulai.
items.en: Students, please take out your pencils.

items.zh: 你把水果拿过来。
items.py: Nǐ bǎ shuǐguǒ ná guolai.
items.en: Bring the fruit over here.

items.zh: 回家以后，我先做作业，然后吃饭。
items.py: Huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ xiān zuò zuòyè, ránhòu chī fàn.
items.en: After getting home, I do my homework first and then eat.

items.zh: 我先坐了一个小时公共汽车，又坐了一会儿地铁才到小刚家。
items.py: Wǒ xiān zuòle yī ge xiǎoshí gōnggòng qìchē, yòu zuòle yīhuìr dìtiě cái dào Xiǎogāng jiā.
items.en: I first took the bus for an hour, then took the subway for a while before I got to Xiaogang's home.

items.zh: 你先把电视节目看完吧，然后再给我回电话。
items.py: Nǐ xiān bǎ diànshì jiémù kànwán ba, ránhòu zài gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.
items.en: Finish watching your TV programme first, then call me back.

items.zh: 先把米饭做好，然后再把一块块新鲜的水果放进去。
items.py: Xiān bǎ mǐfàn zuòhǎo, ránhòu zài bǎ yī kuàikuài xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ fàng jinqu.
items.en: First cook the rice, then put in pieces of fresh fruit.
